findings.highlight: I can't afford to look back
findings.evidenceJa: 背中を向ける余裕もない
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot safely turn away from Rider, so he retreats backward while guarding vital points.
findings.explanation: No room to turn his back becomes no time to look back.

findings.highlight: The sharp edge slowly saws through my body
findings.evidenceJa: 刃物が体中を斬り裂いていく
findings.governingReading: With repeated grinding sounds, bladed attacks slash his body all over.
findings.explanation: Blades rapidly tearing across Shirou’s whole body become one edge slowly sawing through him.

findings.highlight: attacks aimed at my neck and head
findings.evidenceJa: 首、眉間、心臓へと放たれる一撃
findings.governingReading: His ruined arms shield his neck, brow and heart from Rider’s strikes.
findings.explanation: The heart disappears from the vital targets Shirou blocks.

findings.evidenceJa: 確実に脳天を狙った一撃
findings.governingReading: Rider raises the dagger for a blow definitely aimed at the top of Shirou’s skull.
findings.explanation: A certain strike at the crown of the head becomes a generic head strike.

findings.highlight: The end of Rider's dagger is starting to disintegrate
findings.evidenceJa: 短剣の先が、ボロボロと刃こぼれしている
findings.governingReading: After striking below Shirou’s collarbone, the cutting edge at the tip is visibly nicked and crumbling from edge damage.
findings.explanation: The dagger tip chipping becomes disintegration.

findings.governingReading: A single roundhouse kick to Shirou's abdomen sends him through the window.
findings.explanation: The English leaves the kick's roundhouse form unspecified while preserving its target and force.

findings.highlight: going to die...let something like this happen
findings.evidenceJa: それを見過ごしたまま、このまま死ぬのか
findings.governingReading: Already inside the active disaster, Shirou asks whether he will die while merely overlooking and leaving it unresolved.
findings.explanation: Dying while leaving the catastrophe unaddressed becomes dying after allowing it to happen.

findings.evidenceJa: 体中の痛みなんて知らない
findings.governingReading: Shirou no longer cares about pain because anger at himself overwhelms it; his injuries remain.
findings.explanation: Ignoring bodily pain becomes the pain being gone.
